sign: East: Fernstair   Up the old stair: Crowcrest
sign_top: The trees grow so close that noon looks like dusk.
North-east: the high path to Crowcrest.

lines: Forester Haldis: Half the footbridges in this valley rotted in the storm.
Forester Haldis: Here, a bundle of planks. Lay one over any gap with a chalk mark.
Forester Haldis: Chalk marks mean someone measured. Trust them.

smooth: The rock here is oddly smooth, as if many hands had pushed it.
wren: Wren: I come here to listen. The forest is never fully quiet, Hush or not.
wren_intro: Wren: You walk loud for a cartographer. Let's see how you fight.
wren_defeat: Wren: Fair. I'll go back to listening.
olek: Olek: The glowing caps only show at night. Don't eat them.
olek_intro: Olek: You stepped on my patch! A duel, then.
olek_defeat: Olek: Fine, fine. Watch your feet next time.
sorrel: Sorrel: Up here the path splits. Crowcrest east, the old ruins north.
sorrel_intro: Sorrel: Made it up the stair? Then you've earned a real duel.
sorrel_defeat: Sorrel: Ha! The forest picked a good one.

lines: A clear spring in a small clearing. The water is cold and tastes of moss.
An old cartographer's stone. A compass rose is cut into it, worn almost smooth.
Charcoal burner Wido: The old mounds out here have words on them, if you know how to look.
Charcoal burner Wido: Lay paper on the stone and rub this over it. The letters come back.
Charcoal burner Wido: Five mounds I know of, from the forest to the rails. Mind the dead, they don't mind you.
